name: Harness tree: ticket branch grouping and archive
description:
1. **Ticket** — the harness tree must group tickets by the branch saved **in the chat model** (not the checkout), tickets without it land in an `unknown` node, the project menu must sit on each project node (archive is per project), and "Remove chat" becomes "Archive chat".
2. **Root cause** — `create()` only wrote the branch into `meta_data["harness_mode"]`, which the chat index never projected, so the list endpoint fell back to `current_branch()` and every ticket showed under the checked-out branch; "unknown" was unreachable.
3. **Fix** — `Chat.branch` set on create and projected through the chat index (`SCHEMA_VERSION` → 2), `_session_branch()` now returns `''` instead of guessing; grouping extracted to `client/src/utils/harnessTree.js` (Unknown last, current branch first, collapse, search); sidebar menus moved onto the project rows and the delete action now calls `archiveSessions`.
4. **Validation** — 2 new harness-session tests + chat-index projection test (`37 passed`) and 7 new client unit tests for the tree grouping; `qa_review_changes` green.
5. **Closed out** — merged `--no-ff` into `main` in the `codx-junior-platform` worktree (`b1c8be69`), re-ran the 37 tests green on merged `main`, then removed the ticket worktree and deleted `codx/task/We-must-save-the-harness-ticket-branch-i-dea749f0`.

**Delivered.** Nothing to run — this is a summary of the finished and merged ticket.

export const UNKNOWN_BRANCH_KEY = '__unknown__'

  return String(session?.branch || '').trim() || UNKNOWN_BRANCH_KEY

 * @returns {Array<object>} Branch header rows followed by their sessions.
 */
export function harnessTreeRows(sessions = [], { currentBranch = '', search = '', collapsed = [] } = {}) {
  const term = String(search || '').trim().toLowerCase()
  const matches = session => [
    session?.name,
    session?.description,
    session?.preview,
    session?.model
  ].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(term))

  const groups = new Map()
  for (const session of sessions || []) {
    const key = branchKey(session)
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, [])
    groups.get(key).push(session)
  }

  const active = String(currentBranch || '').trim()
  const order = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a === active) return -1
    if (b === active) return 1
    if (a === UNKNOWN_BRANCH_KEY) return 1
    if (b === UNKNOWN_BRANCH_KEY) return -1
    return a.localeCompare(b)
  })

  const rows = []
  for (const key of order) {
    const all = groups.get(key)
    const visible = term ? all.filter(matches) : all
    if (term && !visible.length) continue
    const isCollapsed = (collapsed || []).includes(key)
    const unknown = key === UNKNOWN_BRANCH_KEY
    rows.push({
      session_id: `branch:${key}`,
      __branchHeader: true,
      __branchKey: key,
      __branch: unknown ? '' : key,
      __branchLabel: unknown ? UNKNOWN_BRANCH : key,
      __branchUnknown: unknown,
      __branchCount: all.length,
      __branchRunning: all.filter(item => item.phase === 'running').length,
      __branchCurrent: !unknown && key === active,
      __branchCollapsed: isCollapsed
    })
    if (isCollapsed) continue
    for (const session of visible) rows.push({ ...session, __branchKey: key })
  }
  return rows
}
